gaff.definition:
n. a sharp metal spike or spur that is fastened to the leg of a gamecock
n. a spar rising aft from a mast to support the head of a quadrilateral fore-and-aft sail
n. an iron hook with a handle; used for landing large fish
gaff.translation:
n. 鱼叉, 斜桁
vt. 用鱼叉捉, 用鱼钩拖上来, 欺骗

gaff topsail.translation:
n. 鲶鱼
[网络] 斜桁帆

gaff-topsail.definition:
n. A small triangular sail having its foot extended upon
   the gaff and its luff upon the topmast.

gaffe.definition: n a socially awkward or tactless act
gaffe.translation: n. 过失, 失态, 出丑

gaffed.translation:
n. 鱼叉；斜桁；低级娱乐场所
vt. 用鱼叉捉；用鱼钩拖上来；欺骗
vi. 赌博
n. (Gaff)人名；(英)加夫

gaffer.definition: n. an electrician responsible for lighting on a movie or tv set
gaffer.translation: n. 乡下老头, 老人, 领班, 照明工

gaffers.definition:
n. an elderly man
n. an electrician responsible for lighting on a movie or tv set
n. a person who exercises control over workers
gaffers.translation: n. 老人, 乡下老头, 领班( gaffer的复数形式 )

gaffes.definition: n. a socially awkward or tactless act
gaffes.translation: n. 失礼, 出丑( gaffe的复数形式 )

gaffing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Gaff
gaffing.translation: 剥蚀, 剥落, 擦伤

gaffky scale.translation: [医] 加夫基氏表(痰内结核菌计数表)

gaffkya anaerobia.translation: [医] 厌氧加夫基氏球菌, 厌氧性细球菌

gaffs.definition:
plural of gaff
n. a sharp metal spike or spur that is fastened to the leg of a gamecock
n. a spar rising aft from a mast to support the head of a quadrilateral fore-and-aft sail
n. an iron hook with a handle; used for landing large fish
gaffs.translation:
(gaff 的复数) n. 鱼叉, 斜桁
vt. 用鱼叉捉, 用鱼钩拖上来, 欺骗

gaffsail.definition: n a quadrilateral fore-and-aft sail suspended from a gaff
gaffsail.translation: n. [船](上缘张在斜桁上的)斜桁帆
